data.body:
Post-merge validation (guard change 1519 merged f47acb7051 @ 2026-08-07 20:50 UTC).

AC#3 (diagnostic committed) — MET, snapshot-provable: the live ubuntu/py3.11 pytest command now runs with '--timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread' and 'pytest-timeout==2.4.0' is installed. Verified in the CI command line + install log of run 31219729886.

AC#2 (py3.11 cell completes within the 60-min timeout, 3 consecutive Verified runs) — MET: across all 7 post-guard Verified runs NONE reproduced the 60-min hang/cancel signature. Three consecutive clean completions: 31218285449 (success, 11m23s — the former hang leg), 31218769114 (success, 12m22s), 31219729886 (completed the full suite in ~14.5min, then failed only on an unrelated coverage-threshold check specific to change 1520 — not a hang). The '[99%] then silence -> cancelled at 60min' signature is gone.

AC#1 (the hanging test/blocking call is named with a log line or repro showing it stalled) — operator-attested. The specific test was never captured off-runner (does not reproduce locally) and, since the guard merged, the hang has not recurred under normal contention (it was Actions-outage-adjacent), so the guard has not needed to fire to name it. The committed compensating control (per-test 300s thread-method timeout + pytest-timeout) guarantees any recurrence self-names instead of going silent, which is the operational intent. Operator attests this satisfies AC#1.

Closing on operator-attested evidence per operator direction.
